/* Bônus integrados à biblioteca de receitas */
.bonus-highlight{background:#e7efe1;border:1px solid #d8e8d6;border-radius:18px;padding:18px p{max-width:480px}.bonus-day-selector{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:7px;margin:0 0 18px}.day-choice{padding:8px 11px;background:#f6f9f2;border:1px solid #e5eee2;border-radius:30px;color:#64816a;font-size:11px;font-weight:800}.day-choice:hover{background:#edf3e9}.day-choice.active{background:var(--forest);color:#fff;border-color:var(--forest)}.bonus-day-title{font:700 22px var(--title);color:var(--forest);margin:11px 0}.bonus-day-title span{font:600 11px var(--font);color:#7b9481;margin-left:9px}.bonus-meals{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:9px;margin-bottom:17px}.bonus-meal{width:100%;border:1px solid .15s}.bonus-meal:hover{background:#f1f7ed}.bonus-meal img{width:64px;height:54px;object-fit:cover;border-radius:8px}.bonus-meal span{flex:1;min-width:0}.bonus-meal .swap-chevron{color:#85b296}.swap-item p{grid-column:1/-1;color:#77887a;font-size:11px;line-height:1.5;margin-top:9px}.bonus-module>.primary-btn{white-space:normal}
@media(max-width:700px){.bottom-nav{grid-template-columns:repeat(6,1fr)}.bottom-item{font-size:8px}.bottom-item svg{width:19px;height:19px}.bonus-module{padding:15px 12px}.bonus-module .section-heading{align-items:flex-start;flex-direction:column;gap:10px}.bonus-module .section-heading .outline-btn{font-size:10px}.bonus-highlight{padding:14px 12px}.bonus-highlight b{font-size:17px}.bonus-meals{grid-template-columns:1fr}.bonus-day-selector{max-height:124px;overflow:auto}.pantry-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.swap-item{grid-template-columns:1fr 20px 1.1fr;gap:7px}}

/* Refinamento de usabilidade MOBILE-FIRST — lote real */
@media(max-width:700px){
  .bottom-nav{grid-template-columns:repeat(6,minmax(0,1fr));gap:1px;padding:8px 5px calc(8px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom))}
  .bottom-item{min-width:0;font-size:9px;gap:4px;padding:6px 0 5px;white-space:nowrap}
  .bottom-item span{max-width:100%;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
  .bottom-item svg{width:21px;height:21px}
  .content{padding:24px 14px calc(118px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom))}
  .recipe-cover{aspect-ratio:1.18}
  .recipe-card h3{font-size:15px;line-height:1.22}
  .recipe-card-desc{font-size:11.5px;line-height:1.45;min-height:36px}
  .recipe-card-body{padding:12px 11px 13px}
  .recipe-meta{font-size:10px;justify-content:space-between}
  .recipe-dialog-image{height:clamp(210px,44vh,300px);object-fit:cover}
  .recipe-dialog{max-height:95dvh;width:100%;overflow-y:auto;overscroll-behavior:contain}
  .recipe-detail{padding:22px 19px calc(34px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom))}
  .detail-columns section{line-height:1.6}
  .search-field{font-size:16px;height:54px}
  .info-notice{font-size:11.5px;line-height:1.55}
}
@media(max-width:360px){
  .bottom-item{font-size:8px}
  .bottom-item svg{width:20px;height:20px}
  .recipe-grid{gap:9px}
  .recipe-card-body{padding:10px 9px}
  .recipe-card h3{font-size:13.5px}
  .recipe-meta{font-size:9px;gap:4px}
  .card-category{font-size:8px}
}

/* Indicação editorial de técnica culinária consultada */
.recipe-source{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:flex-start;border:1px solid #cbded0;background:#f0f7ef;color:#315b44;border-radius:12px;padding:11px 12px;font-size:12px;line-height:1.5;margin:16px 0}
.recipe-source svg{flex:none;color:#1f694d;margin-top:1px}
.recipe-source a{font-weight:750;text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:2px}
@media(max-width:700px){.recipe-source{font-size:11px;padding:10px}}

/* =========================================================
   COZINHA LEVE | Design editorial (mobile-first)
   Design system: off-white + forest + soft terracotta
   ========================================================= */
:root{
  --forest:#24533d; --forest-deep:#153c2b;
  --mint:#e6eee4; --pale:#fbfaf5; --cream:#f6f0e5;
  --orange:#b97048; --text:#263d30; --muted:#727a70;
  --line:#e9e6dd; --white:#fffefa;
  --shadow:0 8px 26px rgba(65,56,39,.055);
  --font:'DM Sans',system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif;
  --title:'Fraunces',Georgia,serif;
}
body{background:var(--pale);color:var(--text)}
.sidebar,.topbar,.bottom-nav{background:#fffefa}
.sidebar{border-color:var(--line)}
.logo-area{gap:13px}.logo-symbol{border-radius:50%;width:40px;height:40px;background:var(--forest);font-size:24px}
.logo-words{font:600 22px/1.08 var(--title);letter-spacing:-.7px;display:block}
.logo-words span{display:inline;color:var(--orange);margin:0}
.logo-words small{display:block;font:700 8px/1.4 var(--font);letter-spacing:1.25px;margin:6px 0 0;color:#898d80}
.nav-item{font-weight:600;border-radius:9px;color:#68786c}
.nav-item.active{background:#edf3eb}
.topbar{border-color:var(--line)}
.topbar-left{font-weight:700}
.topbar-logo-icon{font-size:25px}
.content{max-width:1120px}
.page-title{font:600 clamp(31px,3vw,42px)/1.14 var(--title);letter-spacing:-1.35px}
.section-heading h2{font:600 clamp(22px,2.2vw,28px)/1.2 var(--title);letter-spacing:-.45px}
.lead,.section-heading p,.content-header p{color:#787d73}
.primary-btn,.outline-btn,.light-btn{border-radius:11px;font-weight:700;box-shadow:none;transition:background .18s,transform .18s}
.primary-btn{background:var(--forest);color:#fffefa}
.primary-btn:hover{background:#356a4d}
.outline-btn{border-color:#d9ded4;background:#fffefa}
.search-field{background:#fffefa;border-color:#e4e3d9;border-radius:12px;box-shadow:none}
.search-field::placeholder{color:#9a9f94}
.chip{background:#fffefa;color:#697a68;border-color:#e4e6dc;font-weight:700}
.chip.active{background:var(--forest)}
.recipe-card{border:1px solid #ebe9e0;background:#fffefa;border-radius:15px;box-shadow:0 5px 15px rgba(52,53,40,.055)}
.recipe-card h3{font:600 18px/1.2 var(--title);letter-spacing:-.3px}
.recipe-card-desc{color:#778274}
.recipe-meta{border-color:#f0ece6}
.recipe-cover{background:#e8e3d6}
.card-category{box-shadow:0 1px 5px rgba(0,0,0,.06);font-weight:700;color:#486951}
.heart-btn{background:#fffcf7f2;color:#3c6652}
.info-notice{background:#f3f0e8;border:1px solid #ece4d6;color:#807a6e}
.info-notice svg{color:#a8957d}
.result-line{color:#7b8b7e}
.recipe-detail h2,.bonus-module h2,.more-view h2{font-family:var(--title)}
/* Editorial home */
.welcome-line{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:10px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:1.2px;color:var(--forest);margin:1px 0 20px}
.welcome-leaf{font-size:19px;line-height:1;color:var(--orange)}
.welcome-rule{height:1px;flex:0 1 32px;background:#b9c4b4}
.home-hero{display:grid;grid-template-columns:47% 53%;background:#eae7da;border-radius:19px;overflow:hidden;margin-bottom:38px;min-height:285px}
.home-hero-image{position:relative;overflow:hidden;min-height:285px}
.home-hero-image img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;position:absolute;inset:0;filter:saturate(.96)}
.photo-credit{position:absolute;bottom:12px;left:13px;background:#fffaf6d9;color:#485548;font-size:9px;font-weight:700;border-radius:12px;padding:5px 9px}
.home-hero-body{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:center;padding:31px clamp(20px,3.2vw,43px)}
.editorial-overline{font-size:10px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:1.25px;color:#906c52}
.home-hero-body h1{font:600 clamp(33px,4vw,52px)/1.04 var(--title);letter-spacing:-1.7px;color:#254c36;max-width:380px;margin:11px 0}
.home-hero-body p{font-size:13px;line-height:1.6;color:#536453;max-width:350px;margin-bottom:20px}
.home-hero-cta{font-size:12px}
.categories-head{margin-bottom:16px}
.home-category-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:11px;margin:0 0 38px}
.home-category{display:flex;align-items:center;flex-direction:column;text-align:left;position:relative;padding:0;background:#fffefa;border:1px solid #eeeae0;border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden;color:var(--forest);min-width:0;box-shadow:0 4px 13px #252c1d08}
.home-category img{width:100%;height:114px;object-fit:cover}
.home-category span{padding:11px 25px 13px 10px;width:100%;font-weight:700;font-size:12px;line-height:1.2}
.home-category svg{position:absolute;right:9px;bottom:12px;width:15px;height:15px;stroke-width:2}
.home-category:hover{border-color:#c5d8c6}
.today-heading{margin-bottom:16px}
.today-heading h2{margin-top:4px}
.home-view .search-wrap{margin-bottom:19px}
.home-tool-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:12px;margin-top:28px}
.tool-shortcut{display:flex;gap:12px;text-align:left;align-items:center;background:#e8eee3;border:1px solid #dfe8dc;border-radius:13px;padding:15px 16px;color:#316045}
.tool-shortcut>svg:first-child{height:27px;width:27px;flex:none}
.tool-shortcut>svg:last-child{width:18px;height:18px;flex:none;margin-left:auto}
.tool-shortcut span{flex:1;min-width:0}
.tool-shortcut b,.tool-shortcut strong{display:block;font-weight:800;font-size:13px}
.tool-shortcut small{display:block;color:#718374;font-size:11px;font-weight:500;margin-top:3px}
/* The More section replaces a crowded six-button mobile footer */
.more-menu{display:grid;gap:10px}
.more-menu>button{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:13px;text-align:left;width:100%;background:#fffefa;border:1px solid #e6e5db;border-radius:12px;padding:17px 15px;color:var(--forest)}
.more-menu>button>svg:first-child{width:24px;height:24px;flex:none}
.more-menu>button>svg:last-child{width:17px;height:17px;margin-left:auto;flex:none}
.more-menu>button span{flex:1;min-width:0}
.more-menu b{font-size:14px;font-weight:800;display:block}
.more-menu small{font-size:11px;color:#7a877c;display:block;margin-top:3px}
.about-card{margin-top:25px;background:#f2f1e7;border-radius:15px;padding:22px 20px}
.about-card h2{font:600 24px/1.1 var(--title);color:var(--forest)}
.about-card p{font-size:12.5px;line-height:1.65;color:#6a7669;margin-top:12px}
/* Other views: higher contrast, less dashboard-style decoration */
.summary-tile,.meal-slot,.bonus-module,.review-card{background:#fffefa;border-color:#e9e7db;box-shadow:none}
.summary-tile strong{font-family:var(--title)}
.bonus-highlight{background:#e9eadd;border-color:#e4e5d8}
.bonus-highlight b{font-family:var(--title);font-weight:600}
.bonus-module .section-heading h2{font-family:var(--title)}
.bonus-meal,.pantry-row,.swap-item{background:#fffefa}
.bonus-meal b{font-family:var(--font);font-size:13px}
.day-pill{background:#fffefa}
.bottom-nav{border-top:1px solid #e9e4da;box-shadow:0 -7px 19px #4743270d}
.bottom-item{font-weight:600;color:#8c9389}
.bottom-item.active{color:#255c43}
.recipe-dialog{background:#fffefa}
.recipe-detail{background:#fffefa}
.recipe-dialog-image{object-fit:cover}
.image-unavailable{background:#e3e5d8}
@media(max-width:700px){
  .app-shell{background:#fbfaf6}
  .topbar{height:61px;padding:0 18px}
  .topbar-left{gap:9px;font-size:15px}
  .topbar-logo-icon{font-size:23px;color:#b1714d}
  .topbar-right .user-avatar{width:31px;height:31px;background:#e7eee5}
  .content{padding:22px 16px calc(114px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom))}
  .welcome-line{font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.7px;margin-bottom:15px}
  .welcome-rule{max-width:14px}
  .home-hero{display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-height:0;border-radius:16px;margin-bottom:29px}
  .home-hero-image{height:198px;min-height:198px;order:0}
  .home-hero-image img{position:absolute;object-position:center 51%;width:100%;height:100%}
  .home-hero-body{order:1;display:block;padding:22px 19px 23px}
  .home-hero-body h1{font-size:32px;letter-spacing:-1.1px;max-width:320px;margin:7px 0 8px}
  .home-hero-body p{font-size:12.5px;line-height:1.55;margin:0 0 17px}
  .home-hero-cta{height:43px;font-size:12px;width:100%}
  .editorial-overline{font-size:9px;letter-spacing:1.1px}
  .section-heading h2{font-size:23px;letter-spacing:-.5px}
  .section-heading p{font-size:11.5px;color:#777e73}
  .categories-head{margin-bottom:12px}
  .home-category-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px;margin-bottom:30px}
  .home-category img{height:99px}
  .home-category span{font-size:12px;padding:10px 20px 12px 11px;min-height:44px}
  .home-category svg{right:6px;bottom:14px;width:14px;height:14px}
  .today-heading{align-items:end}
  .today-heading h2{font-size:23px}
  .today-heading .link-btn{font-size:11px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px}
  .today-heading .link-btn svg{width:13px;height:13px}
  .home-view .search-wrap{margin-bottom:16px}
  .recipe-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:11px}
  .recipe-cover{aspect-ratio:1.03}
  .recipe-card-body{padding:11px 11px 13px}
  .recipe-card h3{font:600 16px/1.19 var(--title);letter-spacing:-.2px;min-height:38px}
  .recipe-card-desc{font-size:10.5px;line-height:1.4;min-height:44px}
  .recipe-meta{margin-top:9px;padding-top:9px;font-size:9.5px}
  .card-category{font-size:8px;left:7px;bottom:7px;padding:4px 6px;max-width:90%;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
  .bottom-nav{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,minmax(0,1fr));padding:7px 9px calc(9px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));gap:3px}
  .bottom-item{font-size:10px;gap:5px;padding:6px 0 5px}
  .bottom-item svg{width:22px;height:22px}
  .bottom-item.active{font-weight:800}
  .home-tool-row{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:9px;margin-top:24px}
  .tool-shortcut{padding:13px 15px;border-radius:12px}
  .info-notice{font-size:11px;line-height:1.5;margin-top:27px}
  .recipe-detail h2{font:600 29px/1.13 var(--title)}
  .recipe-dialog-image{height:250px}
  .recipe-dialog{border-radius:19px 19px 0 0}
  .recipe-detail{padding:22px 20px calc(36px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom))}
  .detail-columns section h3{font:600 22px var(--title)}
  .search-field{height:52px;font-size:16px}
  .page-title{font-size:31px;line-height:1.15;letter-spacing:-.8px}
  .mini-label{font-size:9px}
  .lead{font-size:12.5px;line-height:1.55}
}
@media(max-width:350px){
  .content{padding-left:12px;padding-right:12px}
  .home-category img{height:86px}
  .home-hero-image{height:175px;min-height:175px}
  .home-hero-body h1{font-size:29px}
  .recipe-grid{gap:9px}
  .recipe-card h3{font-size:14px;min-height:36px}
  .recipe-card-desc{font-size:10px}
  .recipe-meta{font-size:9px;gap:4px}
  .bottom-item{font-size:9px}
}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.recipe-card,.home-category,.tool-shortcut{transition:none!important}}

/* COZINHA LEVE — identidade mobile premium inspirada na referência enviada */
:root{--forest:#173c14;--forest-deep:#112e11;--mint:#e9efdd;--pale:#fffaf0;--cream:#fff3df;--orange:#c96b2a;--text:#1f3923;--muted:#6f776a;--line:#eadcc9;--white:#fffdfa;--shadow:0 7px 18px rgba(74,56,26,.10);--title:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif}
body,.main-area,.app-shell{background:#fffaf0;color:var(--text)}
.topbar{background:linear-gradient(120deg,#183c0f,#294d12);border:0;color:#fff;height:80px}
.topbar-left{color:#fff;font-size:20px;font-family:var(--title);font-weight:800}
#topTitle em{font-style:italic;color:#ef8a3d}
.topbar-logo-icon{display:block;color:#f3c896}
.topbar-muted{color:#e1e8d3;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.15px;opacity:.85}
.topbar-divider{background:#7d9d64}
.top-favorites{color:inherit;display:grid;place-items:center;width:42px;height:42px;background:#ffffff16;border:1px solid #ffffff33;border-radius:50%}
.top-favorites:hover{background:#ffffff22}
.sidebar{background:#fcf7ec;border-right:1px solid #e6dac2}.logo-symbol{background:#244b19}.nav-item.active{background:#e3edd8;color:var(--forest)}
.logo-words{color:var(--forest-deep);font-family:var(--title)}.logo-words span{color:var(--orange)}
.content{max-width:1160px;padding-top:31px}
.page-title{font-family:var(--title);color:#213e1e;letter-spacing:-1px;font-weight:800}
.section-heading h2{font-family:var(--title);font-weight:800;color:#203b1a}
.mini-label,.editorial-overline{color:#ad622e;font-weight:800}
.lead,.section-heading p{color:#6c7667}
.primary-btn{background:linear-gradient(160deg,#356910,#1f480d);color:#fff;box-shadow:0 3px 7px #2a4c101f;border-radius:999px;font-weight:800;min-height:44px}
.primary-btn:hover{background:#315d14}
.outline-btn{background:#fff9f0;border-color:#d6d8b9;color:#285126;border-radius:12px}
.search-field{border-radius:50px;border-color:#e6dfcf;background:#fffcf6;box-shadow:0 4px 12px #553c1412}
.search-field:focus{border-color:#779c5d;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px #cee0bb}
.chip-row{gap:7px;margin-bottom:19px}.chip{border-color:#dccba9;background:#fff9eb;color:#3e5b29;border-radius:100px;font-size:11px;font-weight:750}
.chip.active{background:#305809;color:#fff;border-color:#305809}
.recipe-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:14px}
.recipe-card{border-radius:15px;border:1px solid #efdfc7;background:#fff8eb;box-shadow:0 4px 12px #6a512617;transition:transform .2s,box-shadow .2s}
.recipe-card:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 10px 19px #6852221a}
.recipe-cover{aspect-ratio:1.25;background:#e1dfbf}.recipe-cover img{object-fit:cover}
.recipe-card-body{padding:13px 13px 11px}
.recipe-card h3{font:800 17px/1.19 var(--font);color:#173719;letter-spacing:-.3px;margin-bottom:9px}
.recipe-card-desc{display:none}
.recipe-meta{margin-top:7px;border-top:0;padding:0;color:#435138;font-size:10.5px;gap:11px}
.recipe-meta svg{color:#335c24}
.recipe-meta .open-recipe{display:none}
.heart-btn{top:8px;right:8px;background:#193a1cbf;color:white;border:1px solid #fff9;box-shadow:0 2px 8px #17230c42}
.heart-btn.active{color:#ed5958;background:#fff}
.image-pending{position:absolute;bottom:7px;left:7px;background:#fff7e9e8;color:#705e47;font-size:9px;font-weight:800;border:1px solid #f5eddd;border-radius:999px;padding:5px 8px}
.detail-pending{position:relative;display:block;border-radius:0;padding:11px 18px;text-align:center;font-size:11px}
.result-line{color:#777a65;font-size:11px;margin-top:-5px;margin-bottom:14px}
.home-brand-kicker{color:#7d8b55;font-size:10px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.9px;margin-bottom:12px}
.home-hero{position:relative;display:block;border-radius:22px;overflow:hidden;min-height:300px;margin-bottom:17px;background:#21480e;isolation:isolate;box-shadow:0 5px 14px #3b381526}
.home-hero-image{position:absolute;inset:0;height:100%;min-height:0;z-index:-1}
.home-hero-image:after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(92deg,#102c11 0%,#1c3c14ed 38%,#24501549 66%,transparent 100%)}
.home-hero-image img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:70% 50%;filter:saturate(1.08)}
.home-hero-body{position:relative;z-index:1;color:#fff;max-width:60%;padding:35px 25px 27px 31px}
.home-hero .editorial-overline{color:#d7e8b7;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:1.3px}
.home-hero-body h1{display:block;font:800 clamp(31px,3.5vw,48px)/1.07 var(--title);color:#fff;letter-spacing:-1px;margin:9px 0 14px;max-width:380px}
.home-hero-body h1 strong{display:block;color:#fff;font-weight:800}
.home-hero-body h1 span{display:block;font:700 clamp(18px,2.3vw,27px)/1.17 var(--title);margin-top:7px}
.home-hero-points{margin:0 0 17px;padding:0;list-style:none;display:grid;gap:7px;font-size:12px;font-weight:750}
.home-hero-points li{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px}
.home-hero-points li svg{width:17px;height:17px;background:#4d831e;border-radius:50%;padding:3px;flex:none}
.home-hero-cta{background:#fff4de!important;color:#25451c!important;min-width:195px}
.home-quick-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px;margin-bottom:32px}
.quick-link{display:flex;align-items:center;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;gap:6px;background:linear-gradient(#fff4df,#f8e9ca);border:1px solid #f1dfc2;border-radius:15px;min-height:102px;padding:12px 5px;text-align:center;color:#254b26;box-shadow:0 4px 10px #a78a5915}
.quick-link svg{width:26px;height:26px;stroke-width:2.1}.quick-link b{font-size:13px;font-weight:850;line-height:1.1}.quick-link small{font-size:10px;line-height:1.25;color:#586b43}
.home-category-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px;margin-bottom:31px}
.home-category{background:#fff9ed;border:1px solid #ebdbc4;border-radius:13px;box-shadow:0 4px 11px #61491c15}
.home-category img{height:142px}.home-category span{color:#23401d;font-weight:800;font-size:12px}.home-category svg{color:#34641e}
.editorial-overline{font-size:10px}
.info-notice{border-radius:13px;background:#f3ecdf;border-color:#e8dcc6;color:#6b6758;font-size:12px;line-height:1.5}
.bottom-nav{background:linear-gradient(110deg,#163808,#2c520d);border:0;box-shadow:0 -5px 15px #142c1050}
.bottom-item,.bottom-item.active{color:#fff;font-weight:700}
.bottom-item.active{color:#fce26f}.bottom-item.active svg{stroke-width:2.5}
.day-pill.active{background:#345d14;color:#fff}
.summary-tile,.meal-slot,.bonus-module,.shopping-group,.review-card,.pantry-row,.swap-item,.bonus-highlight{background:#fff9ee;border-color:#eadbbf}
.recipe-dialog{background:#fff9ed;border:0;box-shadow:0 20px 70px #21311150}
.recipe-detail{background:#fff9ed}.recipe-detail h2{font:800 clamp(29px,3vw,39px)/1.08 var(--title);color:#193d18}
.detail-stat-row{background:#e9eecf;color:#264a1d;border-radius:12px}
.detail-columns h3{color:#254e20}
.tip-box{background:#f3ead9;border-color:#e3d3b8}
@media(min-width:1080px){.content{padding-bottom:100px}}
@media(max-width:700px){
  .app-shell,.main-area,body{background:#fffaf0}
  .topbar{height:70px;padding:0 18px}
  .topbar-left{font-size:23px;gap:8px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;max-width:calc(100% - 60px);align-content:center;column-gap:7px;row-gap:0}
  .topbar-logo-icon{font-size:29px;color:#f0c58f}
  #topTitle{line-height:1.05}
  .topbar-muted{font-size:9px;line-height:1.15;letter-spacing:.08px;width:100%;padding-left:32px;margin-top:2px}
  .topbar-divider{display:none}
  .top-favorites{height:38px;width:38px}
  .content{padding:17px 14px calc(109px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));max-width:100vw}
  .home-brand-kicker{display:none}
  .home-hero{min-height:232px;height:auto;margin-bottom:14px;border-radius:17px}
  .home-hero-image{height:100%!important;min-height:0!important;order:initial}
  .home-hero-image img{object-position:73% center}
  .home-hero-image:after{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#112c0de0 0%,#153709e0 40%,#15370c79 61%,#09291009 100%)}
  .home-hero-body{display:block;max-width:70%;padding:21px 10px 18px 18px;order:initial}
  .home-hero-body h1{font-size:27px;letter-spacing:-.7px;margin:5px 0 10px}
  .home-hero-body h1 span{font-size:16px;line-height:1.15}
  .home-hero-points{font-size:10px;gap:5px;margin-bottom:12px}
  .home-hero-points li svg{height:14px;width:14px}
  .home-hero-cta{height:36px;min-height:36px;min-width:0;width:auto!important;font-size:11px;padding:8px 12px}
  .home-quick-grid{gap:7px;margin-bottom:27px}
  .quick-link{min-height:88px;border-radius:12px;padding:8px 3px;gap:4px}
  .quick-link svg{width:23px;height:23px}
  .quick-link b{font-size:11px}
  .quick-link small{font-size:8px}
  .section-heading h2{font-size:24px}
  .section-heading p{font-size:11px}
  .home-category-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:9px;margin-bottom:27px}
  .home-category img{height:97px}
  .home-category span{font-size:11.5px;min-height:0}
  .recipe-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:9px}
  .recipe-card{border-radius:13px}
  .recipe-cover{aspect-ratio:1.12}
  .recipe-card h3{font:800 13.2px/1.22 var(--font);min-height:0;margin-bottom:7px}
  .recipe-card-body{padding:8px 9px 10px}
  .recipe-meta{gap:5px;font-size:9px;justify-content:space-between}
  .recipe-meta svg{width:12px;height:12px}
  .recipe-meta .open-recipe{display:none}
  .image-pending{font-size:8px;padding:3px 6px}
  .heart-btn{height:30px;width:30px;top:7px;right:7px}
  .bottom-nav{grid-template-columns:repeat(5,minmax(0,1fr));gap:2px;padding:8px 8px calc(12px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));border-radius:15px 15px 0 0}
  .bottom-item,.bottom-item.active{font-size:9.5px;gap:5px}
  .bottom-item svg{width:23px;height:23px}
  .chip{font-size:10.5px;padding:9px 13px}
  .result-line{font-size:11px}
  .search-field{height:47px;font-size:16px}
  .recipe-detail h2{font-size:29px;letter-spacing:-.5px}
  .recipe-dialog-image{height:245px}
  .recipe-detail{padding:20px 17px calc(28px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom))}
  .detail-stat-row{font-size:11px}
  .info-notice{font-size:10px}
}
@media(max-width:360px){.home-hero-body{max-width:76%}.home-hero-body h1{font-size:25px}.home-hero-body h1 span{font-size:14px}.quick-link b{font-size:10px}.quick-link small{font-size:7px}.recipe-card h3{font-size:12.7px}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*,*:before,*:after{animation:none!important;transition:none!important;scroll-behavior:auto!important}}

</style>


<style id="screenshot-inspired-mobile">
/* Preserves desktop layout while matching the mobile reference direction. */
:root{--forest:#153e0e;--forest-deep:#0e2907;--cream:#faf5e9;--pale:#faf5e9;--text:#172116;--mint:#e8ebd4;--title:'DM Sans',sans-serif}
@media(max-width:700px){
 body{background:#faf5e9;color:#171d12}
 .topbar{display:none!important}
 .content{padding:20px 17px 118px}
 .content.v2-home{padding:0 0 115px!important}
 .v2-masthead{height:186px;display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:flex-start;position:relative;background:radial-gradient(circle at 4% 5%,#577a1e 0,transparent 23%),radial-gradient(circle at 93% 16%,#355d19 0,transparent 28%),linear-gradient(135deg,#112e08,#244a10 68%,#0e2c08);color:#fff;overflow:hidden;border-radius:0 0 22px 22px}
 .v2-masthead:before{content:'☘';position:absolute;left:-34px;top:-42px;color:#8fae41;font-size:115px;opacity:.25;transform:rotate(28deg)}
 .v2-brand{margin-top:24px;display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:flex-start;gap:3px;text-align:center;line-height:1}
 .v2-hat{position:absolute;top:8px;left:calc(50% - 105px);color:#fff}
 .v2-hat svg{width:56px;height:56px;stroke-width:1.1}
 .v2-cozinha{display:block;margin-top:20px;font-size:37px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-1.6px}
 .v2-cozinha em{font-family:'Fraunces',serif;color:#c8e449;font-weight:500;font-size:43px;letter-spacing:-1px}
 .v2-subbrand{font-size:14px;line-height:1.25;display:block;font-weight:700;margin-top:7px;letter-spacing:-.2px}
 .v2-top-heart{position:absolute;right:18px;top:20px;background:transparent;border:0;color:white}
 .v2-top-heart svg{width:26px;height:26px}

 .v2-searchholder{flex:1;min-width:0}.v2-searchholder .search-wrap{margin:0;box-shadow:0 2px 7px #1c301b1a;border-radius:40px;border:1px solid #c6bfaf;background:#fffdf7}
 .v2-searchholder .search-field{font-size:14px;height:44px;background:none;border:0;border-radius:40px}
 .v2-filter{flex:0 0 45px;height:45px;background:#e8ebcc;border-radius:15px;border:0;color:#255f15;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
 .v2-feature{width:100%;position:relative;height:170px;overflow:hidden;display:block;border:0;border-radius:17px;text-align:left;padding:0;box-shadow:0 6px 14px #0d290b19}

 .v2-feature-text{position:absolute;inset:14px auto 12px 18px;color:#fff;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start}
 .v2-feature-text strong{font-size:27px;line-height:1.06;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-1.1px}.v2-feature-text strong em{display:block;font-family:'Fraunces',serif;font-size:32px;font-weight:500;color:#f7e6b1}
 .v2-feature-text small{font-size:12px;line-height:1.22;margin:8px 0}
 .v2-feature-text b{margin-top:auto;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;border:1px solid #fff;border-radius:24px;background:#46730e;padding:5px 10px;font-size:11px}.v2-feature-text b svg{width:15px;height:15px}
 .v2-actions{margin:14px 0 22px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:7px}
 .v2-actions button{min-height:98px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:11px 3px;border:0;background:#e9ebd6;color:#193f0d;border-radius:15px}
 .v2-actions button:nth-child(even){background:#f5e8ce;color:#9c4b19}
 .v2-actions button svg{width:32px;height:32px;stroke-width:1.9}

 .v2-heading{display:flex;align-items:baseline;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;margin:12px 0 12px}
 .v2-heading h2{font-size:19px;letter-spacing:-.7px;color:#111;font-weight:800}
 .v2-heading button{background:none;border:0;color:#265c0d;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;white-space:nowrap;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:2px}

 .v2-tile{border-radius:15px;background:#fffdf7;border:1px solid #dbd0b6;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 3px 7px #422b0f15;min-width:0;cursor:pointer}
 .v2-tile-image{height:118px;position:relative}.v2-tile-image>img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
 .v2-tile-heart{position:absolute;right:7px;top:7px;background:#15150e63;border:none;border-radius:50%;width:30px;height:30px;display:grid;place-items:center;color:white}.v2-tile-heart svg{height:20px;width:20px}
 .v2-tile-text{padding:8px 10px 9px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}

 .v2-tile-text small{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:3px;font-size:10px;color:#34422f}

 .v2-cat-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px;margin-bottom:24px}
 .v2-cat-tile{height:117px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;border:0;border-radius:14px;padding:0;background:#7c5434;text-align:left;color:white;box-shadow:0 2px 5px #1b27151a}
 .v2-cat-tile img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
 .v2-cat-tile:after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(0deg,rgba(0,0,0,.84),transparent 77%)}
 .v2-cat-tile span{position:absolute;z-index:1;bottom:10px;left:11px;right:8px;font-size:15px;font-weight:800;text-shadow:0 1px 2px #111;line-height:1.1}
 .v2-cat-tile span small{display:block;font-size:10px;font-weight:500;margin-top:4px}
 .v2-categories{padding-top:0!important}.v2-cattop{height:78px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;background:#143b0c;color:white;margin:0 -17px 18px;padding:0 17px;border-radius:0 0 18px 18px}
 .v2-cattop h1{font-size:21px;font-weight:800}.v2-cattop button{color:white;background:transparent;border:0}.v2-cattop button:first-child svg{transform:rotate(180deg)}
 .v2-categories .v2-cat-grid{gap:12px}.v2-categories .v2-cat-tile{height:138px}
 .bottom-nav{position:fixed;bottom:0;left:0;right:0;background:linear-gradient(#193e10,#0c2806);border-radius:18px 18px 0 0;box-shadow:0 -2px 15px #173a0c23;min-height:72px;padding:6px 5px calc(7px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));z-index:90;display:flex;align-items:stretch;justify-content:space-around}
 .bottom-nav .bottom-item{min-width:0;flex:1;border:0;border-radius:13px;color:white;font-size:10px;line-height:1.15;padding:6px 2px;background:transparent;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:5px}
 .bottom-nav .bottom-item svg{width:24px;height:24px}
 .bottom-nav .bottom-item.active{background:#447b13;color:white}
 .recipe-dialog{width:100%;max-width:560px;max-height:95dvh;border-radius:22px 22px 0 0;margin:auto auto 0!important;background:#faf5e9}
 .recipe-dialog-image{max-height:260px;object-fit:cover}
 .recipe-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px}
 .recipe-card{background:#fffdf7;border:1px solid #e6dcc6}
}

<style>
/* Correção de enquadramento mobile e diálogo de receitas */
html,body{width:100%;max-width:100%;overflow-x:clip;overscroll-behavior-x:none}
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box}
.app-shell,main,.main-content,.content-area,.page-content{min-width:0;max-width:100%}
.recipe-dialog{box-sizing:border-box;max-width:calc(100vw - 16px)!important;width:min(820px,calc(100vw - 16px))!important;max-height:calc(100dvh - 20px)!important;overflow-x:hidden!important;overflow-y:auto!important;overscroll-behavior:contain;margin:auto!important;left:0;right:0}
#recipeDialogContent,.recipe-detail,.detail-columns,.detail-columns>section{width:100%;min-width:0;max-width:100%;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.recipe-dialog-image{display:block;max-width:100%;height:auto;max-height:260px;aspect-ratio:16/9;object-fit:cover}
.detail-stat-row,.detail-actions{flex-wrap:wrap;max-width:100%}
.ingredients-list li,.steps-list li{overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.calorie-disclaimer{font-size:11px;color:#7b897e;margin:5px 0 14px;line-height:1.45}
@media(max-width:600px){.recipe-dialog{border-radius:16px!important;max-height:calc(100dvh - 12px)!important}.recipe-detail{padding:18px 16px 24px!important}.detail-columns{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)!important}.detail-stat-row{gap:8px!important}.detail-actions button{max-width:100%;white-space:normal}}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="app-shell">
